summary: Streams a sentence word by word, each word condensing from particles sampled from its own glyphs before resolving into crisp text.

attributes.name: text
attributes.default: Ultracode runs at xhigh effort and lets the agent plan multi-agent workflows on its own, so big tasks fan out across parallel agents.
attributes.description: The text to stream; runs of whitespace count as one space. Changing it replays the stream with the new text, as do Replay, `restart()`, a width change and the fonts finishing loading.

events.name: done
events.description: Fires once every word has settled into text.

methods.description: Lays out the current `text` again and replays the stream from the first word.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The text to stream; reflects the `text` attribute, or the default sentence when it is missing.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` and its `aria-label` is set to the full text.
The status line ("Streaming…", "Done · N words") is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
motion: With reduced motion, particles start at their final positions, so each word appears in place and fades to text without flying in.
notes: The canvas is a fixed 128px tall with a 23px line height, which fits about five lines; longer text is clipped.
Text is set in the host's font family at 15px, weight 500.

data.note: Pass your sentence as `text`. Without it a sample sentence streams.
